title: 始末だ
meaning_example: Unfortunately, it came to the point where he had to borrow money.

comments.text:
Verb(辞書形) + しまつだ。

The result is always something bad.
comments.html:

comments.text: Meaning: Finally, on top of that. Used to describe when something bad becomes worse.
comments.html: Meaning: Finally, on top of that. Used to describe when something bad becomes worse.

comments.text:
I think this is similar to "〜してしまった" or "〜ということになっちゃった".
In my grammar book, there is no kanji but if you do a google search, 始末だ comes up often.
I'm not very confident about example #5437...
